page: Method Override Middleware for HTTP method spoofing via form/header/query. Executes handler of specified method overriding actual request method. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {methodOverride} from 'hono/method-override'. Use case: HTML forms can only send POST, override to DELETE/PUT/PATCH/etc. Options: app (required, Hono instance), form (optional, string, default '_method'), header (optional, string, header name), query (optional, string, query parameter). Sources: form field, HTTP header, query parameter. Default method field: '_method'. Examples: form: '_custom_name', header: 'X-METHOD-OVERRIDE', query: '_method'. Typical pattern: <form action="/posts" method="POST"><input type="hidden" name="_method" value="DELETE" />. Executes corresponding app.delete() handler. HTTP methods supported: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS, etc. Questions: How to override HTTP method? Why do I need this? Which sources work? How to use form fields? Can I use headers? What about query parameters? What's the default field name? Can I customize it?

sections.manifest: Import statements for Method Override middleware. import {Hono} from 'hono' for main framework. import {methodOverride} from 'hono/method-override' for middleware function. Questions: What to import? Where is methodOverride located?

Method Override middleware basic usage. app.use('/posts', methodOverride({app})). Pass Hono instance as app option. Default checks form field '_method' for method value. Example: form has _method='DELETE' executes app.delete() handler for /posts route. Useful for POST requests that need to be treated as DELETE/PUT/PATCH. Questions: How to enable method override? What's the app option? What's the default field?

Method Override example use case. HTML forms can only send GET or POST, cannot send DELETE/PUT/PATCH. Workaround: add hidden input <input type="hidden" name="_method" value="DELETE" />. Form submits as POST to /posts with _method field. Middleware detects _method='DELETE', executes app.delete('/posts') handler. Customizations: form: '_custom_name' changes field name, header: 'X-METHOD-OVERRIDE' uses header instead, query: '_method' uses query parameter. Multiple sources: can use form, header, or query per request. Questions: Why do HTML forms need this? How does it work? How to customize field name? Can I use headers instead? What about query params?

Method Override middleware options specification. Required: app (Hono instance used in application). Optional: form (string, form field name containing method value, default '_method'). Optional: header (string, header name containing method value, e.g., 'X-METHOD-OVERRIDE'). Optional: query (string, query parameter key containing method value, default '_method'). Each option specifies where to look for the override method value. Can specify form, header, or query as data source. Form example: <input type="hidden" name="_method" value="DELETE" />. Header example: X-METHOD-OVERRIDE: DELETE. Query example: /posts?_method=DELETE. Questions: Which option required? What are defaults? Can I use multiple sources? How to set form field? How to use headers? How to use query params?
